title: Retro Pentium PC
prompt: a beige-and-yellow 1990s Pentium tower PC with a 4x CD-ROM and floppy drive: press power, hit Turbo so the clock display jumps, insert a floppy and a CD, and open the side panel; see-through shows the motherboard, CPU and heatsink, RAM, drive cables and power supply
blurb: Power a beige Pentium tower, toggle its preset Turbo display, load two kinds of media and uncover the boards, cooling and drive cables inside.
